name: AddToAny Field
description: Provides a field type that renders AddToAny share links on entities.
project_description:
Creates an AddToAny Fieldable Widget 
 Creates a field type for "addtoany_field", based on the link field. Useful if you are trying to share a link through AddToAny that is different from the page you are on.

 Share any link by entering the link in the field of type addtoany_field. Alternatively, if you are always wanting to share the existing node that the field is on, you can use the "self_link" switch on the field settings. This is useful if you are displaying the node in a view or a block.

 Requirements

 Version 2.x 

- Drupal: ^9.4 || ^10.0

- AddToAny version 2.x

 Version 1.x 

- Drupal 8 or 9

- AddToAny version 8.x-1.x
